reason: Net-additive bug fix: worker.py::SpeculativeMergeWorker._finalize_inflight records a rebase-landed head's pre-rebase merge commit as a dead base via _record_dead_base (one call plus its comment/docstring site-list edit), cutting the dead-base gate re-verify cascade (task 6279: DF 14 d before 6647 deployed, 93 gate re-verifies, 30 dead-base cascades ~15.7 h, 11 ~5.5 h remaining after 7248).
